films.title: Where Eagles Dare
films.overview: World War II is raging, and an American general has been captured and is being held hostage in the Schloss Adler, a Bavarian castle that's nearly impossible to breach. It's up to a group of skilled Allied soldiers to liberate the general before it's too late.

films.title: Kelly's Heroes
films.overview: A misfit group of World War II American soldiers goes AWOL to rob a bank behind German lines.

films.title: High Road to China
films.overview: A biplane pilot is saddled with a spoiled industrialist's daughter on a search for her missing father through Asia that eventually involves them in a struggle against a Chinese warlord.
